J&K Violence: Homes Demolished, Hundreds Detained After Police Killing

Following the killing of a police official in Anantnag, Jammu and Kashmir, authorities demolished the homes of two suspected militants. In response to the incident, security forces also detained approximately 2,500 individuals. Hundreds of people attended the funeral of the slain police officer, underscoring the impact of the violence.
